content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The organization for this recruitment is Oil India (OIL). It is a prominent government sector company in the oil and gas industry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name announced by Oil India?
faq.answer: Oil India has announced recruitment for various contractual posts, including Contractual Mechanical Supervisor, Contractual Instrumentation Technician, and Contractual Assistant Diesel Mechanic.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this OIL recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available in this Oil India recruitment drive, distributed across different contractual posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly at the specified venue with their documents.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need Class 10th, a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, or Trade certificates in Instrument Mechanic or Diesel Mechanic, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for OIL Walk-in Interview 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for these posts is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Contractual Mechanical Supervisor?
faq.answer: The Contractual Mechanical Supervisor will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 24,960 per month, along with a variable pay of Rs. 960 per day.

faq.question: Q8. What is the walk-in date for Oil India recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in date for the Oil India recruitment for these contractual posts is 26 August 2026. Candidates should attend on this date.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these contractual posts at Oil India.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for OIL Contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for OIL Contractual posts involves a Walk-in for Personal Assessment, followed by Document Verification, and finally a Merit List.
